newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa mostly higher, seen sideways.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa mostly higher, seen sideways.

text.p: Cocoa futures see-sawed to end Wednesday mostly higher on trade short-covering, traders said.
But benchmark September bucked the trend to close three stg down at 1,042 stg a tonne after trading between 1,038 and 1,052.
Traders said some producer hedge selling was seen at the highs.
Other positions saw gains between two and nine stg.
"The market is moving sideways but within its nearby range," said one trader. Cocoa's immediate range is seen at between 1,060 and 1,020 stg.
Volume improved markedly compared to previous sessions. The day's tally stood at 3,962 lots, inflated by Sept/Dec switch trades.
The spread stood at 32 stg at the close, against 25 on Tuesday.
Cocoa broke below the 1,040 region basis September earlier this week as the pound sterling-denominated futures came under pressure from sterling's jump against mark and the U.S. dollar.
Technically, traders said London's cocoa was still on the upside bias, with the market ultimately testing the 1,087-1,108 chart gap which is seen as major resistance.
